Five pieces processed. Here's the triage assessment summary:

## Triage Results

**Created (5 files):**

| Triage file | Library location | Type | Why valuable |
|---|---|---|---|
| `containment-in-philosophy-and-formal-ontology.md` | `philosophy/western/metaphysics/texts/` | text (survey) | Real sources: Aristotle, Casati-Varzi, DOLCE, BFO. Grounds the container term philosophically. |
| `philosophy-of-endeavor.md` | `sociology/work/texts/` | text (survey) | Chisholm, Hornsby, O'Shaughnessy. Grounds the existing endeavor term in action theory. |
| `capital.md` | `sociology/work/terms/` | term | Bourdieu + Penrose. Four forms of capital with field theory. Connects to enterprise, staff, company. |
| `expert-system.md` | `technology/artificial-intelligence/terms/` | term | Clean structural pattern: knowledge base + inference engine. General enough to be useful. |
| `fragment-calculus-for-crossdiscipline-claims.md` | `philosophy/texts/` | text (paper) | Novel framework for managing claims across disciplinary fragments. The closure-as-silent-killer insight is actionable. |

**Assessed but not promoted (remaining triage files):**

| File | Assessment |
|---|---|
| `container.md` | Already exists as `library/terms/container.md` — triage version is a relational-machine spec, not a general term. Keep as spec reference. |
| `carrier.md` | Heavy relational-universe math spec — not library content, stays as spec. |
| `capability-signature.md` | Spec-level definition tied to FARS params blocks. Not a general concept. |
| `data-store.md`, `engine.md`, `flatfile.md` | Computing terms but tightly coupled to the relational machine architecture. The expert-system term captures the general pattern; the specifics belong in specs. |
| `capital` (nuclear reading section) | The Bourdieu content was extracted; the nuclear reading ($K_t \subseteq \mathrm{Fix}(\sigma_t) \setminus H^*_t$) is too spec-level for the library term. |
| `captain-as-nuclear-witness.md`, `first-officer-as-transfer-nucleus.md` | Formal math texts mapping naval command to nuclear quartet. Valuable but deeply tied to the relational universe math — better processed when that math domain is more mature. |
| `information-curvature-conservation-law.md` | Draft paper on Fisher-information geometry. Needs more development before library promotion — the proof sketch is incomplete. |
| `calculus-for-crossdiscipline-claims.md` | Original triage file stays; the library text extracted the portable content. |

No triage files were deleted — they remain as source material.
